True Strike.todo: Uses the caster's normal Strength/Dexterity weapon-attack math (bundled onto the weapon-hit pathway, same as Booming Blade) instead of swapping in their spellcasting ability modifier for the attack and damage rolls, per RAW — no mechanism exists to override which ability score a weapon attack uses. The scaling Radiant bonus (1d6/2d6/3d6 at 5/11/17) is accurate; it's 1d6 too high below level 5 for the same rollDice floor-to-1 reason as Booming Blade. The 'Radiant or the weapon's normal type' choice on the base damage isn't offered — only the bonus die is Radiant, the base weapon damage keeps its own type.
